The Fraunhofer F entry (Sect. 6.1) uses the separate level-less ASD blend row c64, 4861.3250 +/- 0.0014 A, 8 mA shorter. For geocoronal work use the 2s 2S 1/2 - 4p 2P* components at 4861.286949 and 4861.297761 A (air); PALACE applies the Gardner17 Halpha fine-structure fractions (~95 % in the 2s-np pair) to the other Balmer lines.
